greeting.title: Hi, I’m Hwahyeon Park.
greeting.subTitle: Embedded & IoT Software Engineer
greeting.subTitle2: I build IoT systems that connect embedded devices with cloud services, drawing on over two years of professional experience. I have developed ESP32/STM32 firmware and AWS services for a platform designed to support more than 300 devices reporting telemetry at 15-second intervals.
greeting.subTitle3: I am currently completing an MSc in Embedded Systems and Internet of Things at Newcastle University. My dissertation validated relationships between indoor environmental sensors through public-dataset analysis and experiments using Raspberry Pi, ESP32 and Azure IoT.

descBullets: Built an end-to-end IoT platform from the ground up as one of two software engineers, connecting embedded devices with an AWS architecture designed to support more than 300 devices reporting telemetry at 15-second intervals.
Developed firmware for ESP32/FreeRTOS and STM32 devices, implementing BLE, Wi-Fi, MQTT, OTA updates and SPI communication.
Built gRPC and REST services for device management and telemetry using AWS IoT Core, Lambda, EC2, DynamoDB and RDS, and migrated the platform from Azure to AWS.
Resolved integration issues by tracing device behaviour across firmware, BLE/MQTT and AWS, coordinating fixes with teammates and external vendors.
Designed and tested a System Entity Structure (SES)-based security framework for autonomous-vehicle IoT environments.
Developed an IoT encryption library and presented the findings at AsiaSim 2021.
Integrated edge-computing platforms, including Raspberry Pi, NVIDIA Jetson and the Microsoft Vision AI Developer Kit, with Azure IoT for cloud-based sensor data collection.
Analysed Azure Kinect DK skeletal-tracking data to evaluate its suitability for machine-learning applications.
